name: Sales Order - Artist Sheet Monitoring
query:
SELECT
  so.name          AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
  so.customer      AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
  so.transaction_date AS "Order Date:Date:100"
FROM `tabSales Order` so
LEFT JOIN `tabArtist Card` cd
  ON cd.sales_order = so.name
WHERE cd.name IS NULL
  AND so.docstatus < 2
ORDER BY so.transaction_date DESC

name: Default
MR Monitoring
query:
SELECT
  mri.item_code     AS `Item Code`,
  mri.item_name     AS `Item Name`,
  mri.parent        AS `Voucher`,
  mri.qty           AS `Quantity`,
  mri.stock_uom     AS `Unit`
FROM
  `tabMaterial Request Item` mri
JOIN
  `tabMaterial Request` mr ON mri.parent = mr.name
WHERE
  (
    (mr.material_request_type = 'Sales Order' AND mr.sales_order = %(sales_order)s)
    OR
    (mr.material_request_type = 'Manufacture' AND mr.work_order IN (
      SELECT name FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE sales_order = %(sales_order)s
    ))
  )

name: Disbursement Report
SBU Revenue (Sales Order)
query:
SELECT
  soi.cost_center AS `Class:Link/Cost Center :150`,
  SUM(soi.amount) AS `Total Amount:Currency:120`
FROM `tabSales Order Item` AS soi
JOIN `tabSales Order` AS so ON so.name = soi.parent
WHERE
  so.company = %(company)s
  AND so.docstatus = 1
  AND so.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
  soi.cost_center
ORDER BY
  SUM(soi.amount) DESC;

name: Top Customers (Sales Order)
query:
SELECT
  so.customer            AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
  c.customer_name        AS "Customer Name:Data:200",
  SUM(so.grand_total)    AS "Total Sales Amount:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Order` so
JOIN `tabCustomer` c
  ON c.name = so.customer
WHERE
  so.company = %(company)s
  AND so.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND so.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
  so.customer,
  c.customer_name
ORDER BY
  SUM(so.grand_total) DESC
LIMIT 20

name: Subclass Revenue (Sales Order)
query:
SELECT
  soi.custom_subclass AS `Custom Subclass:Link/Subclass:150`,
  SUM(soi.amount)     AS `Total Amount:Currency:120`
FROM `tabSales Order Item` AS soi
JOIN `tabSales Order`       AS so  ON so.name = soi.parent
WHERE
  so.company        = %(company)s
  AND so.docstatus  = 1
  AND so.transaction_date
      BETWEEN %(from_date)s
          AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
  soi.custom_subclass
ORDER BY
  SUM(soi.amount) DESC;
